package.name: uav_ugv_coord
package.description: UAV-UGV coordinate frame merging via AprilTag relative localization. tag_detector_node: detects AprilTags on the downward camera and outputs tag pose in the camera optical frame. coord_merge_node: fuses both vehicles' odometry with the tag detection to compute T(map_uav -> map_ugv) and publishes it as TF + topics.
